Based on a very careful examination of the provided image, here is my report:

**1. Floating Particles:**
I do not see any small, cube-shaped particles (like the ones that appear when breaking blocks) flying outward from the main cluster of stone and wood. There are no stray pixels of green or dark color floating in the blue sky area near the blocks.

**2. Gaps or Holes:**
The cluster of stone and wood blocks appears to be solid. I do not see any obvious gaps or holes where a leaves block might have been broken. The edge of the stone block on the right side of the image looks like a clean, straight vertical line.

**Summary:**
The image shows a solid corner of stone and wood against a clear blue sky background. There are no visible break particles or missing block gaps in this specific zoomed-in section.
